career_ladder.note: Executive Trainees in GAIL (India) Limited undergo 1 year of structured training and probation in Grade E-2. Upon successful completion, they are absorbed as Senior Engineer or Senior Officer in Grade E-2. Promotions through executive management cadres follow GAIL Executive Promotion Policy, annual performance appraisal ratings, and minimum residency requirements.

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Executive Trainees in GAIL (India) Limited is conducted primarily through valid GATE scores in the respective engineering disciplines followed by Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI). Final merit is compiled by assigning 85% weightage to normalized GATE score, 5% to GD, and 10% to PI.

financial_package.note: Compensation is governed by DPE 3rd Pay Revision Committee (PRC) guidelines for Maharatna CPSEs. Executive Trainees receive starting basic pay of ₹60,000 in Grade E-2, mandatory 58% DA constant as of 2025-07-01, cafeteria approach allowances @ 35% of basic pay, HRA (9% to 27%), performance-related pay (PRP), CPF, and medical coverage. Approximate annual Cost to Company (CTC) is ₹18 Lakhs.
financial_package.pay_source_label: GAIL Executive Trainee Recruitment Terms & Conditions
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Entry Basic Pay of ₹60,000, 58% IDA (₹34,800), Cafeteria perks @ 35% (₹21,000), and HRA (9% to 27% = ₹5,400 to ₹16,200), less statutory deductions for Contributory Provident Fund (12% of Basic + DA = ₹11,376), Post-Retirement Medical, and income tax.
official_perks: Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) revised quarterly as per AICPI
Perks and Allowances under Cafeteria Approach @ 35% of Basic Pay
House Rent Allowance (HRA) @ 9%, 18%, or 27% / Company Leased Accommodation / Township quarters
Performance Related Pay (PRP) based on individual performance and GAIL corporate MoU rating
Contributory Provident Fund (CPF), Gratuity, and Defined Contribution Pension Scheme
Comprehensive indoor/outdoor medical benefits for employee and eligible dependents
Group Personal Accident Insurance and Group Life Insurance coverage
